extra.summary: The UOB Lady's Card lets you tailor rewards, earning up to 10 miles per S$1 on a chosen category like fashion or dining. This is ideal for those with predictable spending habits who can maximize the 25X UNI$ earn rate. The flexibility to change categories quarterly is a plus. Consider pairing it with a UOB One Account for potentially boosted earnings.
badges: Up to 10 Miles per S$1 spent

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: 1st Supplementary Card free, $98.10 for subsequent Supplementary Cards

our_takes.our-take: The UOB Lady's Card lets you tailor rewards, earning up to 10 miles per S$1 on a chosen category like fashion or dining. This is ideal for those with predictable spending habits who can maximize the 25X UNI$ earn rate. The flexibility to change categories quarterly is a plus. Consider pairing it with a UOB One Account for potentially boosted earnings. However, factor in the 3.25% foreign transaction fee if you frequently spend overseas.
our_takes.good-for:
Salaried professionals who want to earn accelerated rewards on their chosen spending categories, like dining or fashion.
Individuals aiming to accumulate miles through everyday spending on selected categories, enjoying up to 10 miles per S$1 spent.
Cardholders who appreciate changing their bonus rewards category quarterly to align with evolving lifestyle spending habits.
our_takes.things-to-note:
High interest at 27.8% per year accrues on unpaid balances, increasing debt if you don't pay fully.
Late payment fees are S$100 monthly; set up payment reminders to avoid these charges on your card.
Foreign transaction fees add 3.25% to non-SGD purchases, so factor this into overseas spending.
